target_customer: Larger real estate investors and managers who hold insurance across many properties
problem: Portfolio insurance is spread over many state specific brokers and carriers. Homeflow offered one place to buy, view and change policies and get quotes for acquisitions.
business_model: Insurance brokerage platform earning commissions from carriers

founders.name: Perry Ha
founders.background_notes: YC page: fifth business hire at Hippo, led growth initiatives and sales operations through the IPO; earlier VC associate at Westly Group.

founders.name: Christian Green
founders.background_notes: YC page: staff engineer at Mosaic, led a business line that reached $10M ARR in six months.

competitors.name: Obie
competitors.what: Insurance platform for residential real estate investors
competitors.funding_then: $10.7M Series A in 2021 and $25M Series B in May 2023, total about $39M

technical_complexity.rationale: Quote aggregation across carriers and a policy dashboard were standard web engineering; the hard part was carrier relationships and licensing, not software.

defensibility.rationale: Carrier access and policy history could create some stickiness, but competitors such as Obie and Steadily served the same investors and the wedge was easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Funded landlord insurance startups already served investors. Steadily raised a $3.8M seed and later a Series C; Obie was acquired by The Baldwin Group in January 2026 per a search summary. Neither is shown to have acted against Homeflow specifically.

market_need_then: The YC launch post cites an investor with 200 units whose coverage was split across five brokers and six carriers, and notes brokers are state specific and carriers differ for 1 to 4 unit versus 5 plus unit properties.

branding.domain_note: Used homeflow.me rather than homeflow.com; a different Homeflow Inc. holds a US trademark filed in June 2019 for real estate services. The homeflow.me fetch returned HTTP 402 on 2026-11-17.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and functional per YC launch post

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand; the name collides with other Homeflow companies and a trademark.

outcome_analysis: The reason Homeflow is inactive is not public. It raised about $500K around the YC batch, per CB Insights, and sold insurance to real estate investors against better funded rivals like Obie and Steadily. CB Insights marks Perry Ha as a former CEO and a profile says he later moved to Decagon, but no shutdown or sale announcement was found, so no failure factors are assigned.
notes: The $500K seed rests on a single database (CB Insights, dated 2023-03-28, over two rounds); VCBacked labels it pre-seed dated February 2023, another listing adds Breyer Capital and SSBXi, and Standout lists $20K, so the figure is unverified by any press release. Coverager lists Homeflow as active with no date. Steadily raised a $3.8M seed (builtin article, undated in results) and is not listed as a competitor because no dated source was verified.
